profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer at Black Airplane
profile.summary:
https://www.herbtorres.com

Senior Frontend Developer at Black Airplane employing, but not limited to the following technologies:

Languages, Frameworks and Libraries:
HTML(5) | CSS(3) | LESS | SASS | Javascript | Node.js | ES6+| React | React Hooks | Next.js | Redux | Vue | Pinia | Nuxt | Laravel Inertia | Polymer | GSAP | BodyMovin.js | JSON | Google Maps API | YouTube API | Angular.js | GIT | Firebase | ESLint | Prettier | THREE.js | Sanity.io | AppEngine | Google Double Click Studios | Litmus, Twitter Bootstrap | Zerb Foundation | Google AMP

Tools:
VSCode, GitHub, Vite, Webpack, iTerm, ZSH, Gulp.js, Yeoman, jsFiddle, Codepen, Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects, Adobe Suite, DoubleClick Studios, Litmus, Microsoft Office, Windows/OSX

positions.title: Interface Engineer
positions.description:
- Build marketing and informational websites with an emphasis on maintainability, interactivity, accessibility, localization, and performance.
- Create and maintain build systems, scaffolds and tools used by engineers and designers every day for faster in-house production.
- Developed the official YouTube Rewind Digital Experience (2015 - 2017) showcasing all of the top YouTube Content Creators. Each iteration set a high benchmark which required a step up in digital solutions each time. From WebGL 3D Animation to PixiJS and Canvas Digital Art Creation, the experience grew more entertaining and interactive.
- Developed an internal sprite sheet generator for animators to quickly batch animation frames together for their projects.
- Developed standard and rich media HTML banner ads.
- Developed automated weekly YouTube Music HTML Emails utilizing Google Sheets spreadsheet to quickly build out and send each countries top 100 tracks for the week to subscribers.
- Help develop learning tools, presentations, documentation and other resources for onboarding new engineers and general employee education.
- Learn new technologies, absorb documentation quickly and deploy clean, efficient, bug-free code to the expected standard.
